scope: Fail-closed semantic interpretation correction for predicted inset dash events only. It replaces per-analytic-segment predicted dash member identity with route-wide dash-on event identity while retaining exact ordered source contributor intervals and the complete source-group denominator. Actual rails, endpoints, layout, rendering architecture, GL lifecycle and all authorization boundaries remain unchanged. This artifact is design-only.

nonfinal_unsatisfiable_example_binding.statement: NONFINAL CP1 fail-closed finding: in 1920x1080_ui135, the first 63 cm canonical z interval projects to approximately 123.222 physical pixels. With route-wide 14-on/8-off cadence, its phase is approximately 13.222, leaving an approximately 0.778-pixel dash-on residual in predicted_arc_1. That per-parent core member has no common final-ownership probe pixel across the required 1x/2x/4x profiles; moving or capping it across the boundary falsifies single-parent lineage, while omitting its probe violates the frozen per-member probe contract.

root_semantic_correction_decision_bindin.statement: 请立即冻结V19 route-wide dash-event semantic correction gate+validator/mutations，绑定当前不可满足例1920_ui135 arc0~123.2px/0.8px spill与原gate/orientation gate；锁ordered contributors+interval lineage、source-group denominator保留、gap-only non-rendered、event probe denominator，actual/endpoint不变。design-only，不改prod/CMake/GPU/readiness。

supersession_contract.superseded_original_text: One deterministic InsetTrajectoryProbe per inset core or marker semantic member
supersession_contract.replacement: One deterministic InsetTrajectoryProbe per route-wide predicted dash-event core or endpoint/marker semantic member. Analytic source contributors retain exact interval lineage but do not create subpixel presentation members or probes solely because an event crosses a source boundary.

route_wide_dash_event_contract.generation_order: Clip and order the complete canonical predicted route first; accumulate one continuous route-distance coordinate without reset at analytic source boundaries; classify the global 14-on/8-off cadence; then create one presentation event for every maximal connected dash-on interval.
route_wide_dash_event_contract.event_geometry: Each role may contain ordered triangles from multiple analytic source segments, but uses one event identity and one uniform role token across the complete dash-on event.

source_group_and_gap_denominator_contrac.dash_on_interval_reference: ordered route-wide event key + contributor interval

event_semantic_and_probe_denominator_con.semantic_member_denominator: All route-wide predicted event role members plus unchanged actual rail and endpoint/marker members.
event_semantic_and_probe_denominator_con.probe_denominator: Exactly one probe for every route-wide predicted dash-event core and every unchanged actual core or endpoint/marker member required by the original V19 gate.
event_semantic_and_probe_denominator_con.probe_resolution: After full final draw order, select a deterministic lexicographically first physical pixel that carries the exact event core token in each 1x/2x/4x profile, and likewise one exact same-event halo pixel; background is zero in every sample.
event_semantic_and_probe_denominator_con.no_candidate_behavior: Fail the package with trajectory_inset_probe_unresolved:eventKey; do not split the event, move a probe into another event, omit the probe, change cadence or reduce a denominator.

required_positive_fixtures: 1920x1080_ui135 reproduces the approximately 0.778-pixel cross-boundary residual as one contributor interval inside a full route-wide dash event, not a standalone member
the event has one core, one inner halo, one outer rim, one ordered contributor list and one core probe across 1x/2x/4x
all contributor interval unions and all source route interval partitions are exact with zero missing, overlap, reorder or foreign lineage
gap-only source groups remain in the source denominator with explicit non-rendered gap intervals and no token or probe
event and source mapping digests are camera-independent and standard/CVD identical across all 96 cases
unchanged actual rail, endpoint, layout and orientation tests still pass without inherited world-machine authority
required_fail_closed_fixtures: reset cadence at an analytic source boundary
split one dash-on event into per-parent presentation members
drop, duplicate, reorder, overlap or mix-generation one contributor interval
delete a gap-only source group or classify a gap as missing/clipped
assign a token or probe to a gap interval
omit the probe for an emitted route-wide event core
resolve an event probe from another event or only one sample profile
change actual rail, endpoint, world source mapping, layout, orientation, offscreen architecture or GL lifecycle
